title: @types/emoji-regex is deprecated
summary: npm marks @types/emoji-regex as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. emoji-regex provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."

constraints: @types/emoji-regex only declares types; emoji-regex now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.title: Remove the stub types package
steps.instructions: Remove @types/emoji-regex from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.

steps.title: Use the bundled declarations
steps.instructions: Keep emoji-regex on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from emoji-regex.

verification.purpose: Type-check and build with emoji-regex's own declarations.
